index_boundary: WP-007 cycle 4 cross-source restatement index. Each row states how one candidate wording from HS-023 reads against one candidate wording from HS-011. The index relates records; it never merges, deduplicates, edits, deletes, or ranks them, never elects a controlling wording, never assigns a disposition or a conformance state, and never resolves a conflict. Only a recorded owner decision may do any of those things.
relationship_vocabulary_note: RESTATES means the two wordings state the same expectation. NARROWS means the subject wording is more specific or more limited than the related wording. BROADENS means the subject wording is more general or wider in scope. CONFLICTS means the two wordings cannot both be satisfied as written. NEW means the executor found no counterpart in the other source.
